description: This file is a script for automating testing and regression checks for a project involving build processes, file system snapshots, and process management using Node.js. It includes functions for argument parsing, directory and file operations, process execution with timing, and result analysis related to the 'gateway-watch-regression' workflow.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main orchestration function that performs build, snapshot, watch, and analysis steps for regression testing.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command line arguments to override default options.

methods.name: ensureDir
methods.description: Creates a directory if it does not exist.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Normalizes file paths by replacing backslashes with forward slashes.

methods.name: listTreeEntries
methods.description: Lists files and directories under a given root, returning a sorted list of relative paths.

methods.name: humanBytes
methods.description: Converts byte counts into human-readable strings.

methods.name: snapshotTree
methods.description: Creates a filesystem snapshot of a directory, including counts of files, directories, symlinks, and total size.

methods.name: writeSnapshot
methods.description: Writes filesystem paths and statistics of target directories ('dist' and 'dist-runtime') to snapshot files.

methods.name: runCheckedCommand
methods.description: Runs an external command synchronously, throwing an error if it fails.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Returns a Promise that resolves after a specified delay.

methods.name: buildTimedWatchCommand
methods.description: Constructs a command configuration to run a timed watch process, capturing timing info.

methods.name: parseTimingFile
methods.description: Parses timing output from the 'time' command to extract CPU and elapsed times.

methods.name: runTimedWatch
methods.description: Runs the watch process with timing, process control, and captures stdout/stderr for analysis.

methods.name: parsePathFile
methods.description: Reads and parses a list of file paths from a given text file.

methods.name: writeDiffArtifacts
methods.description: Compares two directory snapshots and records added and removed paths.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Outputs an error message to stderr.

methods.name: detectWatchBuildReason
methods.description: Analyzes output logs to determine why a build was triggered during the watch.

methods.name: buildRunNodeDeps
methods.description: Gathers environment and path configuration for running 'run-node' related commands.
